title: Final Answers
description: Essential Criteria: The student provides both final velocities of the particles as seen from each other's frames.

title: Momentum Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly calculates the velocities of both particles using their given momenta.

title: Velocity Transformation
description: Important Criteria: The student applies the velocity transformation formula correctly to find the relative velocities.

title: Correct Units
description: Optional Criteria: The student includes the correct units (c) in their final answers.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student fails to account for the correct signs in the relative velocities, leading to incorrect answers.
